description: Bucketed process-telemetry aggregate flowing northbound past the site boundary: ≥1-minute buckets for process variables, ≥1-hour buckets for anything attributable to an individual person's activity (hikari N7 inheritance, ADR-2605265000 §1.3 precedent). Full-rate data never leaves the site historian. Per ADR-2606111000 §5.

bucketSeconds.description: ≥60 for process variables; ≥3600 for person-attributable signals

minMilli.description: bucket minimum in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)

maxMilli.description: bucket maximum in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)

meanMilli.description: bucket mean in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)

lastMilli.description: last sample in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)
